definitions.explanation: A position one occupies, especially a coveted post, rank, or title. Carries a sense of authority or prestige attached to the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座|ざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: to take the position of company president

examples.japanese: ⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座|ざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いた→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: He successfully defended the champion's title.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座|ざ}をめぐって⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A fierce struggle continues over the top position.

notes:
Often abstract: not a physical chair but a position of rank or honor. The same kanji also serves as a suffix in ⟦{星座|せいざ}→星座：06313_seiza⟧ (constellation) and in theater names like {歌舞伎座|かぶきざ}, which are separate uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座|ざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to take up a position
- {座|ざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to seize a position from someone
- {座|ざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧: to compete for a position
- {座|ざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明|あ}け{渡|わた}す: to give up one's position
